setup.js: (()=>{window.__avisos=[];const re=/N[ãa]o foi poss[ií]vel|Erro ao|Tente novamente|Algo deu errado|Falha ao|Something went wrong/i;const chk=(t)=>{t=(t||'').trim();const m=t&&t.match(new RegExp('[^]{0,40}('+re.source+')[^]{0,40}','i'));if(m&&window.__avisos.length<10)window.__avisos.push(m[0].replace(/[\n\r\t ]+/g,' '))};new MutationObserver(ms=>{for(const m of ms){m.addedNodes.forEach(n=>chk(n.textContent));if(m.type==='characterData')chk(m.target.textContent)}}).observe(document.body,{childList:true,subtree:true,characterData:true});chk(document.body.innerText);setInterval(()=>{document.querySelectorAll('[data-sonner-toast][data-type=error]').forEach(t=>{const s='TOAST DE ERRO: '+t.textContent.trim().slice(0,90);if(!window.__avisos.includes(s)&&window.__avisos.length<10)window.__avisos.push(s)})},300);return 1})()

steps.text: Exporte um relatório de compras e vendas por usuário

steps.js: (async()=>{const norm=t=>t.replace(/[\s\u00a0]+/g,' ').toLowerCase();const esp=["Relatório por Usuário", "Período", "Usuários incluídos", "(3 de 3)", "Desmarcar todos", "Excel", "Visualizar / PDF"];let out='';for(let i=0;i<20;i++){const els=[...document.querySelectorAll("[role=dialog],[role=alertdialog]")];const el=true?els[els.length-1]:els[0];if(!el){out='DIFERENTE: sem elemento';}else{const t=norm(el.innerText);const falta=esp.filter(e=>!t.includes(norm(e)));if(!falta.length)return 'OK: '+esp.join(' | ');out='DIFERENTE: faltou '+JSON.stringify(falta)+' em: '+t.slice(0,240);}await new Promise(r=>setTimeout(r,300));}return out})()

steps.js: (async()=>{for(let i=0;i<40;i++){const w=(window.__pops||[]).slice(-1)[0];let h=null;try{h=w&&w.document&&w.document.body&&w.document.body.innerText.length>200?w.document.documentElement.outerHTML:null}catch(e){return 'ERRO '+e}if(h){const u=new TextEncoder().encode(h);let s='';for(let k=0;k<u.length;k+=8192)s+=String.fromCharCode.apply(null,u.subarray(k,k+8192));return 'HTML:'+btoa(s)}await new Promise(r=>setTimeout(r,250))}return 'SEM RELATORIO'})()
